terra.problem: The text commands the horn and signal; it does not say they were sounded or sent. It also does not establish that everyone heard the horn.
The passage commands that the horn be sounded; it does not say the horn is already blowing.
The timer comparison does not match the action of changing an attack plan. Calling the attackers flexible also makes light of the threatened attack.
The passage says the shepherds will pitch their tents; it does not say they have already done so or that nobody is folding them up.
The explanation gives a purpose for the LORD's warning that the text does not state.
The passage does not explicitly identify Jeremiah as the speaker in verse 10.
The passage does not explicitly identify Jeremiah as the speaker in verse 10. It also does not say whether the people lost track of the word.
The passage does not explicitly identify Jeremiah as the speaker in verse 10.
The text says the houses will go to others, but it does not specify whether those others include their children.
The claim about what prophets and priests were supposed to be is a Bible fact beyond this passage and needs a supporting reference.
The text gives the words “Peace, peace”; it does not say the speakers repeat them over and over.
The passage does not say that “Peace, peace” is the whole message they give.
Saying they have lost the ability to blush adds that they once had it, which the text does not say.
